title: Cap for keren hishtalmut and IRA (regulation 4): 2% a year of balance, no deposit-fee item

source.title: Provident Funds (Management Fees) Regulations 2012, reg. 4, 5 (Hebrew Wikisource; Nevo mirror)

balance_cap.notes: Keren hishtalmut, IRA (קופת גמל בניהול אישי), central fund, sick-pay, holiday and other-purpose funds: management fee "בשיעור שלא יעלה על 2% לשנה" of the balance. Regulation 4 has no fee-from-deposits item (il-finance reading: a deposit fee has no basis here).
